title: APK static + Frida triage
steps: `apktool d app.apk -o out` and `jadx -d out-jadx app.apk`; read `AndroidManifest.xml` for exported components and permissions.
Grep for URLs, API keys, `firebase`, `flag`, and native library names; inspect `lib/*/` with `strings`.
Open exported components with `adb shell am start`; check `adb logcat` for leaked data.
Hook checks with `frida -U -f <pkg> -l hook.js` or `objection`; bypass root/emulator/pinning only in the challenge app.
falsifier: No exported component/secret and runtime checks pass with a legitimate flow; the flag may require a server interaction.
